Download First Touch Soccer 2020 (FTS 20) Mod Apk  Obb Data for Android with improved graphics and latest transfers update.

Another edition of FTS series is out which is the year 2020 version, lovers of this high quality football game will find it very interesting when playing the latest FTS 20 Apk.

What you can see in First Touch Soccer 2020 is the new background which comes with a nice graphics and easy to use navigation menus in terms of setting up your games easily.

The buttons has been giving new looks, they are now easy to be use and move around your screen smoothly during game play without any form of hanging.

New players have been added or transferred to there respective clubs without any form of misplacement or transfer issues where by users reported that some players are in the wrong clubs. 

While you can still build and modify your stadium, new stadium have been added to FTS 2019 Android whereby as a manager in First Touch Soccer, you can boast of having a stadium.

Leagues such as La Liga, Seria A, Premier League, Champions league and other local leagues have been added to FTS 2020 Apk.

In this post not only are you going to get the FTS 20 Apk offline, but you will also need to download the Obb and Data files which has all the modifications to the game.

The soccer pitch in First Touch Soccer 2020 mod looks so real including crowd reactions  during game play.

There are different forms of formation to choose from, such as the famous 4-4-2, 4-3-3 among many others. You can also see the preview of your formation before the starting of a game.

How To Install First Touch Soccer 2020 Apk Obb Data

Is not all about downloading First Touch Soccer 2020 Apk Obb Data files above, but carefully following the steps below to install and extract obb data files by going to Android folder in phone memory.

Use Zrchiver app To Extract FTS Obb Data >> Download Zarchiver App Apk

Steps to Install FTS 2020:

  1. Using Zarchiver App.
  2. Locate FTS 2020 Obb Data files in Downloads folder.
  3. First click on Obb FTS 2020 Zip File.
  4. Options Menu will come up.
  5. Click “Extract” and go to phone memory.
  6. Click Android Folder.
  7. Click Obb folder.
  8. Now Click extract icon which looks like a arrow pointing downwards.
  9. Obb FTS 2020 zip file will be extracted successfully upon reaching 100%.
  10. Similarly Extract Data FTS 2020 Zip file by going to Android folder and then click data folder.

Note that FTS 2020 Data Zip File is very important, it contains transfers update files and many  other important games files, make sure you extract it also.

Features Of First Touch Soccer 2020 Mod Apk

At this point some of you will like to know the latest features of First Touch Soccer 2020 Apk Mod for Android, below are the highlighted features of the game:

  • Unlimited Coins: with this you wi able to buy and transfer players from one club to another, not only that, you can use the unlimited amount of money or coins in First Touch Soccer 2020 hack to purchase kits and upgrade players skills.
  • New Stadium: Stadiums now look better with new ad-boards logos, crowds, new pitch design with green grass and emblems.
  • Full Players Transfers: there is a transfer market available in the game, where you can trade or buy best players from another club to your own personal club as a manager.
  • Manager Mode: This mode is where you can manage all the activities of your team and receive club news such as next fixtures, tips, players performance and many more, this feature was updated in the new FTS 2020 for Android.
  • Updated Leagues: like i mentioned earlier new updated leagues such as Serie A, Bundesliga, Brazilian leagues, La Ligaa etc and also new leagues where added.
  • HD Graphics: in terms of graphics, first touch soccer 2020 had the best and most recent graphics update which players in the pitch look so real.
  • Game Modes: All known game modes of First Touch Soccer such as Manager Mode, Tournament mode, All star players, training are still available in the game and they have been updated.
  • Miscellaneous: other features added includes new game buttons, new background images, updated commentary, new broadcast station such as ES Sports and more.
